subtitle: Lesson 19 · A worked Change Request scenario

code:
Requirement from the Change Manager:

1. Change Request moves to "Scheduled"
2. Email the assigned CAB group
3. Use the existing Change Notification template
4. A reply from CAB becomes a comment on the Change
caption: Four real requirements, built from what this chapter already taught.

steps.label: Trigger
steps.sub: Change Request State changes to Scheduled — a record condition

steps.label: Recipient
steps.sub: the assigned CAB group, deliberately, not a convenient record field

caption: Reuse the existing template; don't write a new body.

code:
Table:           Change Request
When to send:    Updated
Field condition: State changes to Scheduled
Who receives it: CAB group
Email Template:  Change Notification
caption: Same structure as Lessons 16-17, new table and audience.

steps.label: Watermark
steps.sub: the outbound email must carry one identifying this Change Request

steps.label: Inbound Email Action
steps.sub: must exist for the Change Request table, or replies go nowhere

steps.label: Record Action
steps.sub: appends the matched reply's text as a comment
